hero.title: Every Relationship. Every Deal. One View.
hero.description: Track clients from first touch to close with drag-and-drop pipeline, AI-generated strategy, and automatic lifecycle progression.

body: Every interaction with a client across all channels feeds into one timeline — voice recordings, emails, chats, meetings, CRM entries, and person-scoped AI sessions. The Consultant module analyzes your pipeline across five strategy dimensions — financial, marketing, sales, leadership, and products — then generates actionable opportunities with effort estimates and business-goal-fit scores. Click 'Create Campaign' on an opportunity and it pre-populates in Marketing.

pipeline.label: Sales Pipeline
pipeline.caption: Drag deals between stages. When a deal hits "Won", the client auto-promotes to active. AI generates strategy suggestions per stage.

benefits.title: 360° customer view
benefits.desc: One click shows linked projects, operations, reports, emails, meetings, and documents. Every interaction across every channel, per person.

benefits.title: Auto lifecycle
benefits.desc: Lead → prospect → active → churned. Close a deal and the client graduates automatically. No manual status changes.

benefits.title: AI sales strategy
benefits.desc: The Consultant module analyzes your pipeline, identifies priority audiences, and generates actionable opportunities with effort estimates.

scenario: You're prepping for a call with Henderson. Open their CRM card — see every email thread, meeting note, voice recording, and project update in one timeline. The AI brief tells you sentiment is positive, there's one open action item from last week, and the proposal is $3K under their stated budget. You walk in armed with context no competitor has.

cta.heading: Other CRMs track contacts. HABOS tracks relationships.
